description:
Who are the 24 elders in Heaven? Has the Euphrates River dried up? Find out the answers on this episode of 3ABN Today Bible Q & A with John Lomacang, James Rafferty, and Shelley Quinn. Hosted by Angela Lomacang.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. Is there a difference between the Spirit of God and the Holy Spirit? 

2. Who are the 24 elders in Heaven? Are they there now? 

3.  In Matthew 5:17 Jesus tells us that He did not come to abolish the law but to fulfill it.
What is Paul telling us in Ephesians 2:15?  

4. Do the dead dream? Can you please explain what this sleep is like? 

5.  Could you please explain the 1290/1335 prophecy of Daniel 12? 

6. What is the meaning of Revelation 1:4, the 7 spirits before the throne? 

7.  I have been seeing where the Euphrates River has dried up. The Book of Revelation 9:14 & 16:12 says when it’s dried up demons will be released. Is it safe to say the River is dried up and we are at the point of waiting for 1/3 of mankind to be killed? Has the Euphrates River dried up?

8.  When we stand before the judgment seat of Christ will it just be us and Him only or will everyone be there together?  Will we be alone at the Judgement Seat?

9.   In referencing John 4:23-24, Would you please elaborate on what worshiping in spirit and truth is? What does it mean to worship in spirit & truth?

10.  Can you please explain Proverbs 22:5?  

11.  In Judges 11:37-38 we find the word bewail. More specifically in verse 38 which says "And she went with her companions and bewailed her Virginity upon the mountains" what does it mean? Did she commit fornication or what happened? Can you explain what happened in Judges 11:37-38?

12.  Can you help me understand the fate of Judas? If Christ came to earth to be slain for us then why is Judas guilty? Is it that Christ could have given His life some other way in order to save us and did not have to be betrayed and killed? Could He have just died or offered Himself to the Priest to be slain and it would have accomplished the same purpose?
